## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue and what this change enables or fixes.

## Verification

List relevant commands, scenarios and actual results. Include screenshots for UI changes. Distinguish mocked/offline checks from live service verification.

## Risks or remaining limits

Mention migration, authorization, model usage or deployment implications when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant checks pass locally.
- [ ] context.md and handoff.md reflect the change.
- [ ] Feature/requirements/architecture docs updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, runtime databases or unrelated files included.
- [ ] No unsupported claims about live AI, deployment, security or savings.
